proof_body:
by
  intro p _ r
  constructor
  · intro h hd
    have hu := PadicInt.isUnit_den r h
    have h1 := PadicInt.isUnit_iff.1 hu
    have h2 : ‖(r.den : PadicInt p)‖ < 1 := by
      rw [PadicInt.norm_lt_one_iff_dvd]
      exact_mod_cast (Nat.cast_dvd_cast hd : (p : PadicInt p) ∣ (r.den : PadicInt p))
    rw [h1] at h2
    exact lt_irrefl _ h2
  · exact Padic.norm_rat_le_one
target_source: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (r : ℚ), ‖(r : Padic p)‖ ≤ 1 ↔ ¬ p ∣ r.den
